overlays.narrative_body: Dr. Duckhook studies the green at the Country Club of Jackson, a quiet stretch that makes error feel almost personal. Six victories have not repaired three earlier losses inside Wings. The LLC waits outside the club; afterward, Red, Slob and Chili return.
overlays.math_scope_note: Still alive after a Week 11 loss; no berth clinched at Week 10.

overlays.narrative_body: The commons has heard Chins coming long before the figure appears. Mud Dogs now stands across the Week 11 road, one defeat away from mathematical elimination. A victory could make Chins the first to close another contender's season; a loss would leave both alive.
